mapper.sql: select n.notice_id, n.notice_no, n.sales_order_id, n.sales_order_no, n.customer_name, n.status, n.shop_dept_id, shop_dept.dept_name as shop_dept_name, coalesce(n.warehouse_id, detail_warehouse.warehouse_id) as warehouse_id, coalesce(warehouse_dept.dept_name, detail_warehouse.warehouse_name) as warehouse_name, coalesce(detail_summary.notice_quantity, 0) as notice_quantity, coalesce(detail_summary.delivered_quantity, 0) as delivered_quantity, coalesce(detail_summary.remaining_quantity, 0) as remaining_quantity, n.create_by, n.create_time, n.update_by, n.update_time, n.remark from inv_delivery_notice n left join sys_dept shop_dept on shop_dept.dept_id = n.shop_dept_id left join sys_dept warehouse_dept on warehouse_dept.dept_id = n.warehouse_id left join ( select nd.notice_id, case when count(distinct nd.warehouse_id) = 1 then min(nd.warehouse_id) end as warehouse_id, group_concat(distinct planned_warehouse.dept_name order by planned_warehouse.dept_name separator '、') as warehouse_name from inv_delivery_notice_detail nd left join sys_dept planned_warehouse on planned_warehouse.dept_id = nd.warehouse_id group by nd.notice_id ) detail_warehouse on detail_warehouse.notice_id = n.notice_id left join ( select notice_id, sum(coalesce(notice_qty, 0)) as notice_quantity, sum(coalesce(delivered_qty, 0)) as delivered_quantity, sum(coalesce(notice_qty, 0) - coalesce(delivered_qty, 0)) as remaining_quantity from inv_delivery_notice_detail group by notice_id ) detail_summary on detail_summary.notice_id = n.notice_id
mapper.select: select notice_id, notice_no, sales_order_id, sales_order_no, customer_name, status, shop_dept_id, warehouse_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from inv_delivery_notice where notice_id = #{noticeId} for update
where n.sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId} order by n.create_time desc

select notice_id, notice_no, sales_order_id, sales_order_no, customer_name, status, shop_dept_id, warehouse_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from inv_delivery_notice where sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId} order by notice_id asc for update
